name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 16 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (Home Office; GB News). MI5's annual threat update in October referred to the level as Severe (Novara Media, 14 Oct). Searches on 16 Nov found no announced change to the level.
for_you: Police and MI5 ask the public to stay alert and report suspicious activity; gov.uk sets out how to report it and what to do in an attack. The level reflects a judgement about likelihood, not a specific known threat.
rubric_hit: Threat level Severe: Alert (Severe or Critical)
